top_categories.workout_context: Road-specific control matters at GFNY Toscana. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 78 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Toscana's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before March.
58ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At GFNY Toscana, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Toscana. Train it until it feels boring.
78 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at GFNY Toscana. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on mixed terrain can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 4,557ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.

race_overlay.weather: March in Pistoia, Tuscany, Italy. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before GFNY Toscana. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for GFNY Toscana's 78 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. Use the organizer's current resupply plan for final carry decisions.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at GFNY Toscana. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at GFNY Toscana rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Road Specific, Race Simulation, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 78 miles of mixed terrain in Pistoia, Tuscany, Italy.
